title: ARKNIGHTS X WWF JOINT CHARITY EVENT: COEXISTENCE OPEN
lines: 01 ARKNIGHTS X WWF JOINT CHARITY EVENT: COEXISTENCE OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at Store for a limited-time.

After the event ends, the total donation (deducted 30% of necessary costs, such as service fees, taxes, etc.) gained from the sale of two in-game packs will be used to support WWF’s conservation efforts.
Originite Prime * 1, LMD * 60000, Skill Summary - 1 * 20, Skill Summary - 2 * 10
Operator Purestream will be added into Recruitment in future updates. Please pay attention to related update notices.
INCLUDES: Headhunting Permit * 1, Furniture Part * 100, Originite Prime * 1
Purestream Pack and Nature Conservation Pack can be purchased ONCE ONLY for each player. The total donation amount will be shared at the end of the event on our official website.
DETAILS: During the event, players can login for 7 days to earn the following rewards. Players can earn all the rewards even without login consecutively.
Day 1: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, LMD * 10000
Day 2: Rhodes Island Supplies * 5, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 5: Headhunting Permit * 1, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 6: Rhodes Island Supplies * 5, Chip Catalyst * 1
Day 7: WWF Collaborative Series - Highlands Visitor for Cliffheart * 1, Furniture Part * 200
The Top Emergency Sanity Potions from this event will be expired on June 7, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).
